definitions: Activity involving mental or physical effort done in order to achieve a purpose or result.
Tasks or duties to be done, especially as part of a job or for a specific purpose.
A place where one is employed.
A piece of creative artistic effort, such as a book, painting, or musical composition.
The product or result of a particular action or effort.
examples: I have a lot of work to do.
His latest work is a masterpiece.
The work of art was admired by many.
